status: PRE-REG DECLARED — frozen. No cell additions, no parameter changes, no post-hoc slicing after this document.
hypothesis: Within an ESTABLISHED intraday range (trailing rolling extreme aged >= 4h, width bounded below by 20x RT friction and above by a daily-ATR multiple), a strict penetration of the range boundary is, net of friction, followed by mean reversion toward the range interior sufficiently often that a resting limit order AT the boundary (filled mid-penetration, no confirmation) has positive net EV with fixed TP/SL and a 12h time stop. The claimed edge source is the CONDITIONING on range establishment plus the entry-price differential vs confirmation-based entries — NOT execution mechanics alone.

cells.regime_definition: no additional state filter beyond range-establishment eligibility

exit.label: range-mid TP / 0.35W SL (asymmetric)
exit.tp: range midpoint = entry boundary +/- 0.5*W toward range interior (distance 0.5*W)
exit.time_stop_rule: if neither TP nor SL hit within 48 bars (12h) of entry, exit at the 48th bar close; RT friction still deducted in full
exit.be_trail: FORBIDDEN (project ablation: BE/trail inflates Python BT WR +20pp)

eligibility.boundary_age_rule: a boundary is armed only if the bar that set the extreme is >= 16 bars (4h) before t; sides armed independently
eligibility.min_width_rule: W >= 20.0x RT (2.14p) => TP distance 0.5W >= 10x RT (friction/TP <= 10%, sr_channel_reversal rebrand guard)
eligibility.max_width_rule: W <= 1.5x ATR_D1(14) (excludes trend legs; ATR_D1 from D1 resample of same source, prior-day value)
eligibility.both_boundaries_penetrated_same_bar: no entry on either side; event logged (intra-bar path ambiguous)

entry.sell: limit at range_high; fills iff High[t] > range_high STRICTLY (penetration); entry price = range_high
entry.sides: buy and sell POOLED within the cell; per-side results reported as diagnostics only, never gated or promoted separately (#19 no-post-hoc-slice inheritance)
entry.confirmation: NONE by design (no rejection candle, no RSI, no reclaim) — this is the declared differential vs sweep&reclaim and vs asia_range_fade_v1

friction.rule: full declared RT deducted from every trade PnL; NO credit for limit-fill price improvement (conservative)

cells.same_bar_rule: if both TP and SL price levels lie within any bar's High-Low range (entry bar included, after fill), SL is deemed hit first (conservative)

gates.unit_of_test: cell (pair x lookback x regime x exit). Sides pooled. All four primary gates must pass jointly for a cell PASS.

primary.friction_adjusted_ev: mean net per-trade PnL (pips, after full RT deduction) > 0

null_bootstrap.method: recentered stationary block bootstrap on the cell's net per-trade PnL sequence (trade order preserved), mean block length 10 trades, 10,000 iterations, one-sided: p = P(bootstrap mean under H0-recentered distribution >= observed mean). Pass iff p < 0.05/32 = 0.0015625.

primary.walk_forward: each pair's 365d window split into 3 equal contiguous segments (no shuffling); sign(net mean EV) must be positive in >= 2 of 3 segments. Segments with < 5 trades count as NON-agreeing (conservative).

promotion_conditions_beyond_cell_pass.stressed_rt: net EV must remain > 0 at 1.5x declared RT; 2.0x reported. Rationale: #17 fx_quote_spread_state byproduct — boundary penetrations correlate with spread-anomaly onsets where realized RT is 2-3x nominal; nominal-RT net alone is optimistic for THIS entry type specifically.
promotion_conditions_beyond_cell_pass.asia_window_decomposition: report net EV contribution of fills with entry bar in UTC 00:00-06:59. If a cell's positive EV is majority-sourced from this window, promotion is blocked pending the night-scalper archetype spread-envelope check (overnight spread widening not captured by nominal RT).
promotion_conditions_beyond_cell_pass.procedure: any live/shadow promotion is Rule 1 (365d BT + Bonferroni + pre-reg LOCK already satisfied here, but tier action itself is a separate R1 task, not part of this BT)

notes: SAME-FORM AVOIDANCE MAP (one entry per audit item with risk >= partial):

[H4 horizontal-level edge — falsified, IC null | risk partial-yes] Differentiation is NOT execution (audit correctly rejects 'limit entry alone'). Declared differentials: (1) level constructor — trailing rolling window max/min refreshed every bar with NO pivot confirmation, vs static confirmed H4 swing pivots that persist as historical levels; event = FRESH trailing extreme penetration, not revisit of a confirmed level; (2) population conditioning — events admitted only in established-range state (age >= 16 bars, 20xRT <= W <= ATR-cap); the H4 study measured UNCONDITIONAL touch IC pooled over all market states (N=10-15k); a pooled IC null does not falsify a conditional-subpopulation hypothesis if the conditioned subset is a small fraction of pooled events (dilution). The run MUST report the fraction of our entry events that would also qualify as H4-swing-level touches; if overlap > 50% the differentiation claim is weakened and the result inherits the H4 prior in interpretation. (3) BLOCKING precondition: original ban-scope audit before first run (see gates.hard_preconditions).

[Horizontal sweep&reclaim — falsified, negative EV | risk partial] Estimand is non-identical (entry trigger differs) but mechanism family is shared; adversarial justification (required by audit) is DECLARED here as the testable differential hypothesis: sweep&reclaim entered at the reclaim-confirmation close, surrendering the full sweep excursion + confirmation bars; this design fills AT the boundary. Per-trade entry-price differential = sweep depth + reclaim distance. Hypothesis: that differential exceeds |their negative EV| + the adverse-selection cost of unconfirmed fills (selection into continuation breakouts). This is exactly what the grid measures net; if adverse selection dominates, cells fail the gates — the design does not assume the answer. Additional separation: established-range conditioning (theirs was unconditional liquidity levels).

[asia_range_fade_v1 — OPEN pre-reg LOCK | risk partial] P-10 informal-peek avoidance by ex-ante estimand differential, declared here BEFORE any measurement: lookback 96/192 bars vs their 24; entry limit-penetration with NO confirmation vs their market entry gated on rejection candle + RSI(14) extremes; session unconditional vs their UTC02-06 only; exit 0.35-0.5W SL + 12h time stop vs their ATR-based SL + London-open time stop. No result from this grid may be used to argue for/against asia_range_fade_v1 before its own Phase 3 BT; the Asia-window decomposition here is a friction diagnostic, not a session-edge readout.

[sr_channel_reversal — KILL/RETIRED | risk yes-partial] Rebrand-retry guard, all three audit requirements implemented: (1) friction/TP <= 10% STRUCTURAL via W >= 20xRT eligibility floor (their kill driver was friction = 23.7% of TP 7.2p); (2) limit penetration entry replaces touch-market entry (their losers' MAFE showed touch entry had zero predictive value; entry price here is better by construction); (3) this pre-reg diff section is the estimand-audit documentation. Full RT is still charged with no limit-improvement credit — conservative against their failure mode, not assuming it away.

[Night-scalper archetype — NOT-FEASIBLE-RETAIL | risk partial] Structurally avoided: TP distance >= 10x RT (>= 20-45p depending on pair) cannot sit inside an overnight spread envelope of 5-15p gross; additionally the Asia-window decomposition promotion condition directly tests the archetype's failure mode before any tier action.
